scope: Exact isolated installation and static application-script review only; final native acceptance separate.
receipt_form: Root transcription of returned independent review; reviewer wrote no files.

checks.staged_changes: Three preview tables and isolated version only.
checks.actual_installed_tables: Equal to three frozen preview tables.
checks.restricted_changes: Four states: version/source_scope/property_ids only; one source appended claim_note, previous notes preserved.
checks.actual_four_facts: All original Mean/SD/CV strings unscaled; reported_mean, reported_standard_deviation and exact n6.
checks.uncertainty_semantics: SD absolute elongation percentage points using percent_elongation; CV original relative-percent literal in uncertainty_note.
checks.conditional_screen: Assumptions retained; no scientific-validation or derived-error claim.
checks.deferred_records: Two PA12 and three high-PCL break records absent; no specified_elongation on new properties.
checks.four_language_actual_rendering: Passed en/zh/ja/de with all values and unknowns.
checks.complete_joined_export: All thirteen PA12 objects equal actual installed queries and frozen preview.
checks.wheel_README: Current application-before README, no future acceptance documents.

application_script_static_review.approval_and_input_guards: Exact approved mapping/install receipts, repository inputs, baseline/target snapshots and preview hashes.
application_script_static_review.preservation_guard: All old complete property objects equal.
application_script_static_review.recovery: New external directory; three original tables copied and hashed before replacement.
application_script_static_review.replacement_scope: Three native tables plus local receipts.
application_script_static_review.post_application_guard: Exact target snapshot and complete tables.

limits: Exact artifacts only; native application/recovery/incremental acceptance separate.
Source/mapping approval inherited by exact bindings; not repeated.
No producer/author/build/install/application code, tests or historical regression executed.
Actual isolated imports/queries/complete exports/four languages independently exercised; graph receipt inspected.
No fresh source/PDF/visual/latest-revision audit, file writes, staging, commit or push; not scientific certification.
